note: An operation declaring `x-fern-sdk-method-name` and no `x-fern-sdk-group-name` is the root client's method whatever its `tags`.
A package's sub-clients are ordered by the first operation that belongs directly to each child; a child holding only nested operations comes last.

Servers declared on path items, named by `x-fern-server-name`, apply to their operations and build Fern's multi-URL environment; a path server that is one of the document's top-level servers reads `base`.
A header `apiKey` scheme carrying `x-bearer-format` (any value) sends its key behind `Bearer `; two additional header `apiKey` schemes naming one header are one credential.

One rule, the certified importer's: the first tag and the operationId are each split into lowercase words (a purely camelCase spelling, `^[a-z]+(?:[A-Z][a-z]+)*$`, at its capitals; anything else at runs of characters other than letters and digits).

A path parameter `uuid` is `uuid_` on every operation; a model property `dict` is `dict_` (pydantic's `BaseModel.dict()`, as `copy` and `json` already were); and a whitespace-separated word that folds to nothing keeps its separator, so `viability (%)` is `viability_`, a lone `moisture (%)` is `moisture_` and `seed % weight` is `seed__weight`.
Ruling 7 (init-import-order): no change; crozier keeps its sorted type-checking imports and the catalogued init-type-checking-import-order departure absorbs the permutation.
A section grouped by a snake_case operationId prefix that spells a tag the document declares is titled with the tag verbatim.

A path parameter that does not declare `required: true` is `typing.Optional[...]`, still positional and interpolated; `reference.md` lists it among the optional parameters, and a docstring's worked call names the required path arguments first.
A discriminated union and its variant wrappers are imported in one statement in `types/__init__.py`, at the union's place.
A request body that `$ref`s a component marked `x-fern-ignore` keeps its operation, typed `typing.Any` and passed whole (an array of them is `typing.Sequence[typing.Any]`).

A tag named `core` writes its group's clients into the runtime `core/` package: its `__init__.py` stays the runtime's, the group's clients import the runtime as siblings (`.client_wrapper`) and are formatted like every other generated client.
Cleared by de440bc03 (#669): required content-length and x-forwarded-for header parameters reach no argument; holds at this node's base.
An operationId that is not purely camelCase (here one with a digit) is one word until punctuation splits it, so a tag spelling only its start strips nothing: the method keeps the whole id.
An operationId whose words are its tag's words is the root client's method, named by the tag.
